admission.justification: A separate new bootstrap tool and empty-baseline-first task path were weighed against reusing the fixer; the chosen single-owner admission constrains future authority changes.

alternatives.option: Reuse the existing fixer with a measured pre-baseline admission.
alternatives.reason: It preserves one writer and guards the declared converted root while no attributed line or dependent worktree exists.

alternatives.option: Introduce onboarding_citations_bootstrap with a separate admission and authorization.
alternatives.reason: The existing fixer already performs the work; a second path duplicates authority.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The existing fixer no longer supports the required first-card authoring without duplicating its implementation.

alternatives.option: Adopt an empty baseline first and require a leaf/worktree/closeout for the first overview.
alternatives.reason: It inserts a task between a new user and the first overview, contrary to the taskless bootstrap boundary.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The developer deliberately changes the first-hour taskless boundary.

consequences: The configured-root exception is measured, not asserted by a caller.
After attributed baseline or with linked memory worktrees, the ordinary leaf guard applies.
context: First onboarding must contain anchored converted cards before adoption, but an unborn memory root cannot supply a leaf worktree.
decider: Architect under D47; MIK-R45@v2 supersedes v1 before leaf implementation.
